cards.text: It's the night of the Last Supper, and Jesus is still talking with His disciples. He's warned them the world will hate them, and He's promised to send the Advocate, the Spirit of truth. Now He tells them, "Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me".

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples He's going to the One who sent Him. True or false: He says they keep asking Him where He's going.
Instead of asking where Jesus is going, the disciples' hearts are filled with ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says His going away is for their benefit. Friend, when I leave my bakery for five minutes, it is NOT for anybody's benefit. I come back and there are sprinkles on the CEILING.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples it's for their benefit that He goes away. Why?

answers.text: If He goes He will send the Advocate
They will learn to lead on their own
The world will stop hating them

cards.text: When the Advocate comes, Jesus says, He will convict the world. Three things are on the list: sin, righteousness and judgment.

cards.question: Jesus says the Advocate will convict the world in regard to sin. What reason does He give?

answers.text: They do not believe in Him
They have broken the Law of Moses

cards.text: Next comes righteousness, because Jesus is going to the Father and they won't see Him anymore.

cards.question: Last on the list is judgment. True or false: Jesus says that's because the prince of this world has been condemned.

cards.text: Then Jesus says He still has much to tell them, but they can't bear to hear it yet. Kind of like a brand new baker in my kitchen. Day one, you get a spatula. We'll talk about the big ovens LATER.

cards.question: Jesus can't tell the disciples everything yet. Who does He say will guide them into all truth?
The Spirit of truth is coming to guide the disciples. True or false: Jesus says the Spirit will speak on His own.

cards.text: Instead, the Spirit will speak what He hears, and He'll declare to them what is to come. No guessing. No making it up.

cards.question: The Spirit will take from what belongs to Jesus and disclose it to the disciples. Who does Jesus say the Spirit will glorify this way?
Jesus says everything that belongs to the ___ is His.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me." Baker, that is a riddle with a TIMER on it.

cards.question: The disciples are stuck on Jesus saying "a little while." What do they do?

answers.text: Ask one another what He means
Ask Jesus to say it plainly
Keep quiet and wait it out

cards.question: The disciples keep asking one another about "a little while." True or false: Jesus doesn't know they want to question Him.

cards.text: Jesus brings it up Himself. Then He tells them, "Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices."

cards.question: Jesus says the disciples will grieve. What does He say their grief will turn into?

cards.text: Then Jesus gives them a picture. A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come.

cards.question: Once her child is born, the woman ___ her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
Jesus says the disciples have sorrow now, but He will see them again and their hearts will rejoice. True or false: He says someone could still take that joy away.

cards.text: In that day, Jesus says, they won't ask Him anything. Whatever they ask the Father in His name, He will give them. Friend, the dead batteries I shared that junk drawer with asked for a charger for YEARS. Nobody gave them NOTHING.

cards.question: Until now, the disciples haven't asked for anything in Jesus' name. He tells them to ask and they will receive. Why?

answers.text: So their joy may be complete

cards.text: Jesus says He's been speaking in figures of speech, but an hour is coming when He'll tell them plainly about the Father. In that day they'll ask in His name, and He's not saying He'll ask the Father on their behalf.

cards.question: The Father Himself loves the disciples, because they have ___ Jesus and have ___ that He came from God.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father." No figures of speech. That's as plain as a sugar cookie.

cards.question: After Jesus says He came from the Father and will go back to the Father, the disciples say He is now speaking plainly, without figures of speech. True or false?

cards.text: They say now they understand that He knows all things, and they believe He came from God. Jesus replies, "Do you finally believe?"

cards.question: Jesus says an hour is coming, and has already come. What does He say the disciples will do?

answers.text: Scatter and leave Him all alone
Stand beside Him to the end

cards.question: Jesus says the disciples will leave Him all alone. True or false: He says that means He'll truly be by Himself.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation."

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples they'll have tribulation in the world. Why does He say they can take courage?

answers.text: The world will come to love them

cards.text: Hang onto your apron, baker. This night isn't over, and Jesus still has more to say.
